t: The Architect's Edge: Renormalizing AI & Workflow for Observable Wins
s: This article introduces "Workflow Renormalization," a philosophy applying physics' renormalization trick to combat infinite regress in creative projects and AI collaboration. It advocates for a "No-Gooey" methodology, focusing on banking "observable wins" and treating AI experimentally, like Faraday's field lines, to ensure practical progress over theoretical perfection.
sub: Overcoming Infinite Regress in Projects (Zeno's Paradox)
LLM Ephemerality: Atman/Brahman Analogy for AI
